reason: Research done but thin: WebSearch found no verified October 2026 XLE quote or Brent/WTI price (the only October energy figure was for a different State Street fund, XLEI), and the oil context I found dates from May 2026 (Brent whipsawing between roughly $90 and $120 on the Iran conflict and Strait of Hormuz). The bearish oil view I found (EIA Brent around $55 by end-2026) is old and unverified. I am not trading XLE on evidence I cannot date. MSFT reports fiscal Q1 2027 on 2026-10-27, one day after my 10-26 entry, with Azure growth guided around 45% and about $175B of 2026 capex. Holding through the print is a deliberate event bet that the existing -10% stop and +30% target bound, and I accept it rather than churning the leg before the print. The TLT short fits the current backdrop: the Fed has turned hawkish, the 10-year sits around 5.2% to 5.3% and the 30-year near 5.6% by mid-October reports, and TLT is well off its 52-week high of 92.19. The reporting is mixed-date and approximate, so I am holding the short rather than adding to it. BTC is -6.38% on the leg and the ETH leg is already closed on a stop. Novelty rule is not triggered because this is a HOLD and the existing book stands. Next look: MSFT print on 10-27 and the 11-04 Treasury refunding.
